method: each finding is either EXECUTED against the shipped code (DYNAMICALLY_REPRODUCED) or READ from the actual source (SOURCE_DEMONSTRATED); static reasoning is never reported as a dynamic reproduction
note: 18 findings are read from the actual source; 4 of them (F5, F7, F8, F10) are ALSO dynamically reproduced against the shipped builder. F1/F2/F11/F12/F13/F18 are corrected by C3/C4/C5; F3 by C3 (separate seam); F4 by C6; F5/F6 by C2; F7/F8/F10 by C2; F9 by C2; F14 by C7; F15/F16 by C7 information-sufficiency; F17 by C3/C4. Corrections are recorded as each stage lands; each falsifier test carries a CHANGED ASSERTION marker where its baseline expectation is flipped.

F1_capsuleNotRenderedIntoWorkTask.note: the baseline first engineering UserMessage is `workTask(environment.context, indexTextForPrompt)`. workTask() reads the task half, the PriorResultContext continuation and the pull index, but NEVER context.compiled?.trajectoryCapsule. The P2-D1 Capsule therefore reaches the worker PROCESS but is dropped before the prompt is composed — the PRIMARY D2 source gap

F2_rawWorkerContextIsNotModelVisibility.note: `workWorkerEnvironmentPayload()` returns the FULL attempt context as JSON, and the host adapter forwards `raw.context` to the runner as `environment.context`. JSON transport into the worker PROCESS is not model visibility: only what `workTask()` renders into the UserMessage text is seen by the model

F3_r2ePreworkIsADistinctFactor.note: R2-E's E1 treatment pulls the attempt's compiled HANDLES through the governed pull tool and renders their BODIES (Proof/Reasoning/Procedure capital). A Trajectory Capsule is a different object: a bounded projection of ONE qualified prior Attempt's execution evidence. Conflating them would silently merge two experimental factors

F4_deploymentProfileCannotEnableDelivery.note: the expert `installPalimpsest()` accepts `experimentalTrajectoryContextDelivery`, but the normal `launchDeployment()` profile path neither propagates it nor declares a profile field, and `parseDeploymentProfile()` is strict exact-key. A normal packaged deployment CANNOT enable the experimental capability

F5_durabilityIsCallerSupplied.dynamicEvidence: buildTrajectoryContextCapsuleChecked with durability:'DURABLE' over a fixture whose trusted source is EPHEMERAL records attribution.durability === 'DURABLE'; with no durability it records 'UNKNOWN'
F5_durabilityIsCallerSupplied.note: `assembleCapsule()` sets `attribution.durability = input.durability ?? 'UNKNOWN'`, and `capsuleForConsumer()` accepts a caller-supplied `durability`. Nothing ties the recorded Durability to the ACTUAL trusted Association/Store qualification, so a caller can present historical evidence as durable

F6_productDeliveryDoesNotDeriveDurabilit.note: the product-composed delivery provider calls `capsuleForConsumer({ consumerAttemptId })` with NO durability, so the delivered Capsule records UNKNOWN — even though the composition ALREADY derived `storeDurability` and the Qualifier ALREADY exposes the real `durability`

F7_nonfiniteBudgetNotValidated.dynamicEvidence: buildTrajectoryContextCapsuleChecked with limits.maxSerializedBytes = NaN returns ok:true with serializedBytes 2620 — the whole-byte comparison is bypassed. Infinity is silently reduced to the ceiling by Math.min
F7_nonfiniteBudgetNotValidated.note: `Math.max(0, Math.min(NaN, ceiling))` is NaN and `bytes > NaN` is always false, so a NaN budget disables the bound. TypeScript's `number` provides no runtime validation

F8_legacyMaxTotalCharsNotEnforced.dynamicEvidence: buildTrajectoryContextCapsuleChecked with limits.maxTotalChars = 10 over five 40-char summaries returns ok:true with a total summary length of 200 characters
F8_legacyMaxTotalCharsNotEnforced.note: `maxTotalChars` is DECLARED as the sum of event-summary character lengths, but no code sums summary lengths against it. The field is a documented constraint that is silently ignored

F9_ingestionOutcomeContractMismatch.note: the declared `IngestionOutcome` union is RECORDED | IDEMPOTENT | REJECTED, but the store's own append outcome is APPENDED | IDEMPOTENT and the Recorder passes it through with `as IngestionOutcome`. The declared TypeScript contract and the runtime value DISAGREE

F10_truncationNotDistinguished.dynamicEvidence: a Capsule whose single event summary was clamped to 20 chars reports events[0].truncated === true but capsule.truncation.truncated === false with omittedEventCount 0
F10_truncationNotDistinguished.note: the Capsule-level `truncation` block sets `truncated: omitted > 0` and mentions ONLY omitted events. A Capsule whose summaries were shortened reports `truncated: false`; a source page already PARTIAL is not separated from local truncation

F11_treatmentDeliveryFailureCanBeSilent.note: `workWorkerContext()` wraps the delivery provider in a try/catch and returns a context WITHOUT the Capsule on failure, with NO marker distinguishing 'no lineage' from 'authorized but materialization failed'. Because the Capsule is also not rendered (F1), a Treatment that loses its Capsule would produce a prompt indistinguishable from CONTROL

F12_noHostSectionDigest.note: the host records a digest of the R2-M index section, but there is NO rendered Trajectory Section digest and no full UserMessage digest. Without them a reviewer cannot prove WHICH section bytes entered the actual `agent.followup()` UserMessage

F13_requestHeaderDoesNotEstablishMessage.note: for dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 the model-visible surface event is `user/message`; `request/header` is a header snapshot that carries tools/model, NOT the message text. The product's RECOGNIZED_DSH_EVENT_TYPES does not even include `user/message`. Any D2 user-message proof must read the DSH session's `user/message` event directly

F14_currentRealCapsuleIsNotAFailureTreat.note: the strongest real P2-D1 evidence is a non-model first-party Session created via the capability-refusal probe: its admitted events are session start / configuration, not a documented engineering failure. §12.2 forbids using a startup-only Session as failure-avoidance evidence

F15_sanitizerInformationLimits.note: `sanitizeDshEvent()` excludes raw content and retains only type, seq, turn/step structure, tool NAME, durability, inheritance and a limited structural status. For `tool/result`, `observedStatus = 'recorded'` is NOT proof the tool succeeded. A Capsule CANNOT establish what a tool returned, why a command failed, or what an assistant concluded

F16_eventWindowSufficiencyNotAssumed.note: the Capsule defaults to at most 24 events taken from the START of the read page (a prefix). Nothing establishes that the task-relevant failure evidence lies within that prefix. §11.4 requires the selection policy to be FROZEN before a utility trial

F17_modelVisibleAuthorityIsolation.note: the Capsule already carries framing/authority/doesNotAuthorize, and the worker's scope denies the inherited `palimpsest_` authority surface. What is NOT yet enforced is that the Capsule's TEXT reaches the model under those frames with the authority fields visible and inseparable from the content

F18_controlTreatmentDistinctionNotProven.note: there is no Trajectory presentation seam at all, so the implementation cannot presently produce two arms that differ ONLY in whether the qualified Trajectory Section is present. §13 Group D requires this to be proven, not assumed, once the seam exists
